name: HATT — Heterophily-Aware Temporal Transformer
description: Temporal graph transformer adapted for heterophilic node classification. Modified self-attention to weight dissimilar neighbor representations. Benchmarked against GAT, GCN, H2GCN on Cornell, Texas, Wisconsin datasets with full ablation studies.

name: Prompt-based Business Intelligence System
description: NL-to-SQL intelligence layer using Claude API across heterogeneous enterprise data sources. Schema-grounding, cross-source query orchestration, prompt evaluation loops for injection resistance.

name: Wearable Activity Recognition Pipeline
description: ML pipeline over raw gyroscope/accelerometer data from fitness wearables. Feature extraction, SVM/LSTM/CNN benchmarks, evaluation under noisy/missing-sensor conditions. 94% accuracy on 6-class activity recognition.
